svg.title: South Atlantic Current: OSW editorial reference-route candidate
svg.desc: Equirectangular schematic. Approximately 2100 km. Declared western intermediate-depth SAC reference reach from a 40 W, 39 S current-center context gate to the 16 W, 43 S Mid-Atlantic Ridge float-reach context gate. Excludes upstream Brazil/Falkland confluence paths, unresolved eastern-basin continuation and recirculation. Not a complete current or a digitized float trajectory. Source describes regional geography; OSW selects the drawn route. No measured current axis.
svg.text: OSW approximate western intermediate SAC reach — candidate
Dashed: nominal route · pale: 81 editorial scenarios
Not an observed axis or statistical confidence interval
Source: Boebel et al. (1999), sec. 3.5; OSW selects vertices
Equirectangular OSW atlas ground · scientific review pending
